summary.description: Optional lead from the agent above the document: what it is and what to look at (plain text). http(s) addresses in the text become links.

actor.description: Who acts next. bot (default): Looks good / Changes, or Approve & post / send / continue when action is set; results approve / request_changes. user: the person does it and reports back. The mark names what they did: Posted when task.kind is post_yourself, Sent when action is send, Done only when there is no specific content or action. Results stay done / skipped. none: info only (Got it, plus one optional collapsed note; no section comments; result acknowledged). The bot never acts on user or none.

action.description: Optional verb for the bot primary. post becomes Approve & post, send becomes Approve & send, any other verb becomes Approve & continue. Without it the primary is Looks good.

copy.description: Fix texts to copy, shown near the top. Same shape as decide-list copy.

format.description: markdown: the safe subset (headings, paragraphs, emphasis, inline code, code blocks, lists, quotes, tables, rules, links as text, images by media key). text: plain text, line breaks kept.

doc.description: The document to review. Raw HTML is shown as text. Markdown http(s) links are real links and open in the system browser; other targets stay text.

images.description: Images the Markdown may show with ![alt](key). Anything else, including web addresses, is shown as a quiet placeholder.

key.description: Name used in the Markdown image target.

path.description: Absolute path under a media root (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif).

alt.description: Alt text, used when the Markdown gives none.
